cards.headline: Top NGX-listed tech companies ranked by revenue growth in 2026
cards.what_happened: Revenue growth across nine NGX-listed technology and telecommunications companies was mixed in 2026, according to an analysis of their latest financial statements as of November 8, 2026. Omatek Ventures recorded the highest growth at 650% from a very low base, while Legend Internet posted the weakest performance with a 7.4% revenue decline. Several companies reported rising revenue alongside weaker profitability.
key_facts: Omatek Ventures Plc revenue rose 650% to approximately N1.5 million for the nine months ended September 30, 2026.
Legend Internet revenue fell 7.4% to N1.10 billion for the 12 months ended July 31, 2026.
MTN Nigeria revenue grew 23.6% to N4.61 trillion for the nine months ended September 30, 2026.
eTranzact profit after tax fell 42.7% to N1.38 billion from N2.41 billion.
analysis: Why it matters: The analysis gives investors and regulators a comparative view of revenue and earnings performance across listed technology and telecoms firms, showing that revenue growth did not consistently translate into profit growth.

cards.headline: Kefas signs Executive Order to curb naira abuse in Taraba
cards.what_happened: Taraba State Governor Agbu Kefas has signed an Executive Order aimed at curbing the abuse of the naira in the state. The order is a state-level policy measure affecting currency use.
analysis: Why it matters: A state executive order targeting naira abuse may affect how businesses handle cash and currency transactions in Taraba State.
